name: razor-generate-default-namespaces-by-name
body: RazorCompiler.Generate recognises Razor 6.0's default namespaces by name (AspNetCore for MVC views, __GeneratedComponent for components) and replaces them with the resolved root namespace, and represents the global namespace with an __ApgGlobalNamespace placeholder that it unwraps before C# generation, which also drops Razor's #line hidden for those files. Upgrade to checking whether a namespace directive was applied if a later Razor package changes its defaults.
